visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white off-shoulder knitted sweater and grey trousers, sits on a white textured sofa. She holds a smartphone in both hands, looking down at the screen with a focused expression. The room has dark walls and shelves filled with various toys and books. (2) The scene shifts to a kitchen where the woman is standing by a stove. She pours a dark liquid from a bottle into a small white pot. White text overlays appear on the screen. (3) She is back on the sofa, holding a white mug with both hands and taking a sip. Her expression is relaxed. (4) The woman holds a remote and looks toward a wall where a movie is being projected. The projection shows a blonde woman singing on a stage. (5) She plays with a white Shiba Inu on the sofa, smiling and offering a treat. The dog jumps and interacts with her hands. (6) In a grey-tiled bathroom, she holds a sleek black shower head. She presses a button, and fine water mist begins to spray out across the frame. (7) Graphical technical diagrams appear, showing a female model's face and close-ups of skin pores. Visual callouts and text explain the "ultra-fine bubble" technology. (8) Close-up shots show the shower head spraying water in different modes: a fine mist and a more concentrated stream. Her hand is shown under the water spray. (9) A side-by-side comparison graphic shows magnified skin textures labeled "Before" and "After". (10) The woman is shown again in her white sweater, looking into a mirror or camera and smiling, highlighting her skin. (11) Final close-ups of the black shower head being held and operated, followed by a screen with promotional text and a discount code.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with the sharp, digital sound of smartphone typing and a high-pitched notification chime. A light, upbeat acoustic guitar BGM starts playing in the background at a moderate tempo. (2) A clear, female voice begins narrating with a friendly and professional tone. The BGM remains steady with a rhythmic guitar strumming. (3) As the video demonstrates the shower head, a distinct, soft hissing sound of pressurized water mist is heard, creating a sense of technical immersion. (4) The narrator details technical features, her voice perfectly layered over the BGM with high clarity. A subtle 'pop' sound effect accompanies the transition to pore diagrams. (5) The narration continues with high-density information about product usage, ending with a warm concluding remark as the music fades out gracefully.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Personal Context -> Product Reveal -> Tech Explanation -> Personal Benefit -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lifestyle-oriented commercial designed to promote the Mirable shower head. It starts by showing the creator's relaxing home activities (wine, movies, pets) to establish a context of self-care. It then introduces the product as a way to enhance this experience, using scientific diagrams and personal testimonials to emphasize skin hydration and relaxation benefits.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, detailed feature walkthrough, and the provision of a specific discount code (BN800).
